text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with marginal gains, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. Extreme Fear sentiment (23) paired with rising Bitcoin dominance (55.7%) indicates investors are rotating toward the largest cap assets as a defensive move, while smaller altcoins like Solana are underperforming. The $52B volume is moderate for a crypto market of this size, consistent with a period of uncertainty rather than capitulation or breakout momentum.
